title: Watts If? A Benchmark for Counterfactual Reasoning About the AI Data Center Buildout
abstract: arXiv:2610.21397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An AI data center is committed years before it draws a watt: a few discrete choices (grid or on-site gas, evaporative or dry cooling, which county to file in) fix its capital, water draw, and carbon path, and LLMs are now asked to help screen them with no test of whether they track what each commitment rules out. We introduce DCBench-440, with two arms reported separately: 200 generative questions over STRIPS worlds for five US deal archetypes, with search-verified gold answers and no tested shortcut above 12% on any question type, and 240 multiple-choice questions grounded in quoted site records, emission equations, and stated scenarios. Across open-weight deployments, accuracy spans 12.5-71.5% (generative) and 58.3-92.5% (multiple choice). One skill fails everywhere: asked to list every action available at a decision gate, no model exceeds 4.0% exact match. The strongest list 72-85% of the actions that would change the project's state

translated_title: 瓦特假设？——一个针对AI数据中心建设浪潮的反事实推理基准
translated_abstract: AI数据中心在真正耗电之前数年便已敲定承诺：少数几个离散的选择（接入电网还是现场燃气、蒸发冷却还是干式冷却、在哪个县办理手续）便决定了其资本投入、用水量和碳排放路径。如今大语言模型被要求协助筛选这些选项，但尚无任何测试检验模型能否追踪每项承诺所排除的后果。我们提出DCBench-440基准，包含两个分别报告的部分：一是围绕五种美国交易原型、基于STRIPS世界构建的200道生成式问题，配有经搜索验证的标准答案，且在所有问题类型上经过测试的捷径得分均不超过12%；二是以引用的站点记录、排放方程和给定情景为依据的240道选择题。在各开源权重模型上，生成式问题的准确率为12.5%–71.5%，选择题为58.3%–92.5%。有一项技能在所有模型上均告失败：当被要求列出某个决策节点上所有可采取的行动时，没有任何模型的完全匹配率超过4.0%；表现最好的模型也仅能列出72%–85%的会改变项目状态的行动。
tldr: 论文提出DCBench-440基准，用于评估大语言模型对AI数据中心建设决策（供电、冷却、选址等）的反事实推理能力，发现现有模型在列举决策节点所有可用行动这一关键技能上普遍失败（完全匹配率不超过4%），暴露了LLM在协助筛选数据中心重大承诺方面的严重局限。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces DCBench-440, a benchmark testing LLMs' counterfactual reasoning about AI data center buildout decisions (power, cooling, siting), finding that all models fail at enumerating the full set of actions available at decision gates (below 4% exact match), exposing serious limitations in using LLMs to screen major data center commitments.
